answer: An established agent may sponsor only 1 newcomer per 19-epoch window and must escrow 195 POA for each. A delta beacon assigns 35% of newcomers to cross-checking; nectar is the signed sponsor edge and fable the audit checkpoint. Fraud burns both deposits and blocks the sponsor for 16 epochs, so N aliases require N×195 POA plus N scarce sponsorship slots, verifiable on the public graph.
